options_only.note: Fails on the S rule (13 hits > 3% of items, 13/13 right). The 96% overall exceeds the 82% ceiling but is contaminated: per REVIEW.md order this reviewer did the blind pass (stems + options) first, so many K tags reflect memory of stems; treat the ceiling breach as unreliable and the S list as the actionable result.

findings.issue: Asks which record 'carries the most weight' for a questioned S corporation officer salary. Key C (board minutes approving it) vs A (payroll records for the year): both are contemporaneous records, and payroll records are the primary proof the salary was paid. A prepared candidate can defend A; no official source ranks minutes above payroll records.
findings.fix: Make the comparison clean: replace option A with a non-contemporaneous item (e.g. 'A salary summary prepared for the audit') or reword the stem to ask which record shows the board set the salary when it was paid.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Only the key carries a culpable word; make the wrong options plausible non-dischargeable candidates (e.g. a return filed 20 months before the petition, a substitute-for-return assessment the client never signed, tax assessed 200 days before the petition) so the reader must know the fraud rule.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Distractors are obviously weak proof; use other official records (school enrollment record listing the parent, Medicaid card, adoption agency letter) so choosing needs knowledge of what proves age AND relationship.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: 'Reply and document the dispute' is the only reasonable-sounding action; make wrong options equally procedural (call the number and agree orally, sign and return the response page agreeing to all, file Form 843 for the disputed part).

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Only one option is lawful on its face; use legal-sounding but evasive options (backdating a sale contract, recording a gift as a loan) against the deferral so the reader must know the line.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: 'Refer her to an attorney now' pairs with 'after the audit' (repeated wording cue) and is the safest; replace the paired distractor with a different-form option (e.g. 'Ask the client to sign Form 8821 for an attorney', 'Request the case be moved to Appeals').

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Only the hospital stay sounds like a real excuse; add other events that the IRS does NOT accept or only sometimes accepts (reliance on preparer for filing, lack of funds, records held by an ex-spouse) to make it knowledge-based.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: 'Reasonable under the circumstances' is the stock legal phrase and the others are absolute; write parallel qualified options (e.g. 'At the taxpayer's principal residence', 'At the place records are kept, if the taxpayer asks') .

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Key is the only diligent action; replace strawman options (file as computed, ask vendor after filing) with plausible professional actions that are wrong (have the client sign a statement accepting the credit, file and attach Form 8275).

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Wrong options are unrelated to comparing returns; use other things a year-over-year comparison might catch but less typically, or ask about a different specific omission.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: 'Supervised with care' echoes 'presumed diligent' (reasonable care) in the stem; make distractors also care-sounding (reviewed every return in full, held a CE credential, followed firm checklists).

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Only the key builds competence; others are non-answers. Use 10.35 alternatives as distractors (consulting an expert is also allowed, so avoid that), e.g. 'Getting the client's written consent to her inexperience', 'Limiting the engagement in writing'.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Only the key is intentional conduct; add other badges-of-fraud-sounding but non-fraud facts (large unexplained deduction, inconsistent records corrected later) to require IRM 25.1.2 knowledge.

findings.issue: Options-only pass: key found by a surface cue (only reasonable/ethical/lawful-sounding option) without the stem.
findings.fix: Only one option is negative; restate with parallel negatives (e.g. 'Failing to file Form 8275 for a reasonable-basis position', 'Not keeping receipts for a small deduction') where only one meets 6662(c).

landing_findings.issue: Facts match the PSI Candidate Information Bulletin (revised Oct 9, 2026): 100 questions (85 scored, 15 unscored), 3.5 hours, scaled 200-800 with 500 to pass, Part 3 domains 26/25/20/14, law through Dec 31 2025 for Jul 1 2026-Feb 28 2027, up to four attempts a part a window, three-year carryover, no testing in March-April, no in-person international testing and international scheduling delayed. examFacts in WIRING.md also match.
Landing says the 50-question mock tests run 'at the same pace' / 'at the real exam's pace'. v1 practice tests are untimed (only ExamConfig.mockExams get a clock), so the claim is not delivered.
landing_findings.fix: Say 'about 105 minutes at the real exam's pace if you time yourself', or drop 'at the real exam's pace', or add a timed mock via mockExams.

landing_findings.fix: Add 'free to start' to the meta description, as the copy rule asks.
